text:
eva-partner: looking to list a single bundle in our marketplace that covers Snowflake + Databricks + two vector backends (Qdrant, Milvus). partner portal wants SKU-driven procurement. can Redwood support one commercial SKU with fulfillment hooks?
anya-gtm: short answer: yes if we use manifest metadata to drive fulfillment. we prefer a single sales SKU for contracting simplicity, with manifest keys that tell the marketplace which HW profile and vector options to provision.
mike-partners: from partnership ops: i agree single SKU is cleaner. partner asks for explicit HW SKUs so their procurement team can match inventory numbers. is that feasible without exploding our catalog?
sylvia-eng: engineering prefers to avoid duplicating SKUs. recommended: single "Connector Bundle" SKU + manifest fields: "hw_profile":"dev|standard|htp", "vector_backends":["qdrant","milvus"], "residency":"eu|global". fulfillment system can map hw_profile->partner HW SKU.
raj-arch: i'll own the mapping table. propose resource profiles:
- dev: 1xA10g, 2vCPU metadata
- standard: 1xA40, 4vCPU metadata
- htp: 2xA100, 8vCPU metadata
also include expected qps and token throughput per profile.
natalie-legal: legal prefers single commercial SKU + metadata tags. require explicit residency flag and a certification data handling clause in the manifest. suggested manifest clause: "cert_data_policy":"synthetic_or_anonymized_only; no PII in logs; redaction_required".
eva-partner: partner expects license_key flow in the marketplace fulfillment. can manifest include a callback URL for license provisioning webhooks?
ops-bot: automation: webhook support available. manifest field "fulfillment_hook" accepted by marketplace API.
sylvia-eng: for cert lab and marketplace listing we need a short unattended smoke run. happy-path steps we'll include in the manifest as strings under "install_commands" and "smoke_test_commands". sample installer + smoke snippet below:
```
# install
redwood-connector install --bundle connector-bundle --target snowflake --target databricks --vector qdrant --credentials @secrets.json
# databricks deploy with unity-catalog role mapping file
redwood-connector deploy --target databricks --unity-catalog --role-map roles.json

-- simple smoke SQL for Snowflake
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rw.smoke_table (id int, text string);
INSERT INTO rw.smoke_table SELECT seq4(), 'hello' FROM table(generator(rowcount => 10));
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rw.smoke_table;
```
This will validate ingest -> index -> query path.
mike-partners: good. timeline: partner wants listing published week of May 6. can cert lab run a focused smoke pass in 48-72h to unblock manifest submission?
raj-arch: we can provide a prioritized smoke with telemetry sampling off by default (0%) and a sample run to validate event shape only. full telemetry validate later.
sylvia-eng: blocker: Databricks Unity Catalog mapping not in mainline build yet. options: provide a lightweight shim for cert lab, or backport the feature. shim will be faster for timebox.
eva-partner: shim is fine for certification. partner will run GA validation post-listing.
natalie-legal: reiterate certification must use non-prod or synthetic data. include NDA step if logs are requested.
ops-bot: cert-scheduler: available slots for Redwood: 2024-04-16 10:00 UTC (2h), 2024-04-18 14:00 UTC (3h). Reply with slot id to reserve.
anya-gtm: reserve 2024-04-16 10:00 UTC for a 2h happy-path smoke. i'll upload draft manifest to shared drive with these manifest keys: ["install_commands","smoke_test_commands","hw_profile","residency","vector_backends","fulfillment_hook","cert_data_policy","license_flow"].
mike-partners: action items: anya -> manifest + single SKU draft; raj -> hw_profile->partner-HW-SKU mapping table; sylvia -> shim + install/smoke commands; natalie -> cert data clause and residency text; ops-bot -> reserve slot and provide cert-run runbook id.
ops-bot: reserved slot 2024-04-16 10:00 UTC; runbook id PARTNER-5601.
sylvia-eng: i'll deliver shim + smoke commands in 48h. i will also include unattended flags so cert lab can run headless.
raj-arch: delivering resource table by COB today.
natalie-legal: uploading residency + redaction language now.
eva-partner: thanks, i'll confirm marketplace portal supports fulfillment_hook and license callback. if they require separate HW SKUs we may need a simple mapping doc to attach to the offer.
mike-partners: excellent. any other blockers?
sylvia-eng: none other than eng-ml backport request; i'll ping them after this thread.
anya-gtm: great, i'll post the manifest link once uploaded. thanks everyone. :heart:
